title: Enlarger print exposure 1.3 with Y / M filter shifts
description: Same as 'defaults' but with enlarger.print_exposure = 1.3, enlarger.y_filter_shift = +10 CC and enlarger.m_filter_shift = -5 CC (the shifts are added to the neutral CC values coming from the upstream neutral_print_filters.json database).

enlarger.exposure_factor_note: the exposure factors are scalars (upstream shape 1 x 1 x 1) that are broadcast over the three channels of the print exposure

print_balance.shape_note: the upstream arrays are 1 x 1 x 81 (one mid-grey patch), they are stored here flattened in wavelength order
